group_assessment.weighting: A founding WWOX laboratory with a carcinogenesis department; MacLeod brings native BPDE chemistry. Northern, western and flow cytometry in two cell lines are the group's competence and weigh as competent observation - of single representative experiments. The mechanistic readings (ATR vs ATM, bulky-adduct transcription block, S-phase checkpoint control) are the group's hypotheses, two of which the Discussion sets against each other. Primary for the gene is not primary for the disease: nothing here concerns neural cells or WWOX-DEE.

entries.proposition: SYSTEMS: two transformed lines only, MCF-7 and Saos-2. DATO. No primary, non-transformed, neural or in vivo system.
entries.snippet: MCF-7 and Saos-2 cells were maintained in complete IMEM
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods > Cell Lines and Treatments, sentence 1

entries.proposition: AGENT: UV-C 254 nm, not UV-B or UV-A. DATO.
entries.snippet: irradiated with UV-C emitted by five narrow band germicidal lamps emitting predominantly 254 nm.
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods > Cell Lines and Treatments, sentence 2

entries.proposition: BPDE: 0.5 uM, 30 min pulse in serum-free medium. DATO.
entries.snippet: final concentration of BPDE was 0.5 μM.
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods > Cell Lines and Treatments

entries.proposition: CAFFEINE: 1 h pre-treatment at 5 or 10 mM, maintained after UV. DATO.
entries.snippet: pretreated for 1 h with complete IMEM containing 5 or 10 mM caffeine
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods > Cell Lines and Treatments

entries.proposition: THE CAFFEINE CONTROL is sham-treated cells without caffeine. DATO. No arm receives caffeine without UV, so an effect of caffeine alone on WWOX mRNA or on the cycle profile is not measured.
entries.snippet: Control cells were sham-treated in complete IMEM without caffeine.
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods > Cell Lines and Treatments

entries.proposition: NORTHERN PROBE: 1200 bp WWOX cDNA covering the whole coding region. DATO; it cannot distinguish full-length from shorter isoforms of similar composition on a Northern without size information, and no size marker is shown.
entries.snippet: A 1200 bp BamHI-EcoRI restriction fragment of WWOX cDNA clone, spanning the whole amino acid-coding region, was used as probe.
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods > RNA Isolation and Northern Blot Analysis

entries.proposition: ANTIBODY: in-house affinity-purified rabbit polyclonal (ref 23), 280 ng/mL stock at 1:500. DATO; no specificity control in this paper.
entries.snippet: The affinity purified primary rabbit polyclonal antibody used against WWOX (pure concentration at 280 ng/mL) was developed at our laboratory [23]
entries.anchor: Materials and Methods > Western Blot Analysis

entries.proposition: WHY MCF-7: chosen because WWOX is abundant in it. DATO as the authors' rationale.
entries.snippet: MCF-7 breast cancer cells were chosen as a model system for these studies because WWOX is abundantly expressed in this cell line.
entries.anchor: Results > UV and BPDE but not IR, sentence 1

entries.proposition: UV-C LOWERS WWOX AND FHIT mRNA at 24 h. DATO as stated.
entries.snippet: Interestingly, as compared to control, WWOX and FHIT mRNA levels dramatically decreased by 24 h in the UV-irradiated samples (Figure 1A).
entries.anchor: Results > UV and BPDE but not IR, sentence 3

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1A UV BLOT, NATIVE TILES (raster 2357x4200). Lanes 0, 10, 15 J/m2. WWOX and FHIT: clear band at 0, no discernible band at 10 or 15. p21: weak at 0, strong at 10, very strong at 15. GAPDH: similar at 0 and 10, VISIBLY WEAKER at 15. So the 10 J/m2 loss is not a loading artefact while the 15 J/m2 lane is loading-confounded. Each probe row is a separately framed strip; no quantification, no replicate blot shown.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 1A UV section: WWOX and FHIT rows band at 0 only; p21 rises with dose; GAPDH band at 15 J/m2 markedly lighter than at 0 and 10.
entries.anchor: Figure 1A (PDF p.13), native tiles x0-1179 y0-2800

entries.proposition: TEXT CITES PANELS: cell number halves (Figure 1B) with no loss of viability (Figure 1C). DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: cell number decreased about twofold at 24 h postirradiation (Figure 1B) without a significant decrease in cell viability (Figure 1C).
entries.anchor: Results > UV and BPDE but not IR, sentence 4

entries.proposition: CAPTION: triplicates, mean +/- SD. DATO; no statistical test is reported for any panel.
entries.snippet: Each treatment was performed in triplicate and is represented as the average ±SD.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1B-C, NATIVE TILES. The panel axes read B = 'Cell viability (% of untreated)' and C = 'Total Cell Number (% of untreated)', which matches the caption and is the REVERSE of the running text's citation. B: first group ~100/~97/~95%; a later pair falls to ~74% viability; another ~95%. C: cell number ~55% and ~50% in the first group, ~44% and ~55% in the later pairs. No x-axis treatment labels are legible in the manuscript raster, so the ~74% viability bar cannot be assigned to a named treatment.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 1B and 1C: panel B y-axis label Cell viability (% of untreated); panel C y-axis label Total Cell Number (% of untreated); one dark bar in B near 74; no x-axis treatment labels.
entries.contradicts_needle: cell number decreased about twofold at 24 h postirradiation (Figure 1B)

entries.proposition: IR DOSE CHOSEN AS 'approximately equitoxic', supported by a citation of the Northern (Figure 1A), not by a toxicity panel. DATO for the text.
entries.snippet: MCF-7 cells were irradiated with IR at a dose (10 Gy) approximately equitoxic to 10 J/m2 of UV-C radiation (Figure 1A).
entries.anchor: Results > UV and BPDE but not IR, paragraph 2

entries.proposition: IR 10 Gy DOES NOT LOWER WWOX or FHIT mRNA. DATO (single dose shown).
entries.snippet: did not cause a significant reduction of WWOX or FHIT transcripts.
entries.anchor: Results > UV and BPDE but not IR, paragraph 2

entries.proposition: DOSE RANGE, DATA NOT SHOWN: IR 20-40 Gy ineffective, UV 20-30 J/m2 effective. DATO as a statement only.
entries.snippet: Higher doses of IR (20, 30, and 40 Gy) were also ineffective in decreasing WWOX and FHIT mRNA levels, whereas increasing doses of UV (20 and 30 J/m2) caused downregulation of WWOX and FHIT transcripts similar to that obtained with 10 and 15 J/m2 (data not shown).
entries.anchor: Results > UV and BPDE but not IR, paragraph 2

entries.proposition: BPDE: 'dramatic decrease' of WWOX and FHIT at 24 h. DATO as stated.
entries.snippet: also caused a dramatic decrease of WWOX and FHIT transcripts at 24 h post-BPDE treatment (Figure 1A).
entries.anchor: Results > UV and BPDE but not IR, paragraph 3

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1A BPDE AND IR BLOTS, NATIVE TILES. BPDE 0.5 uM: WWOX band REDUCED BUT CLEARLY PRESENT (not abolished as at UV 10 J/m2); FHIT reduced; p21 strongly up; the GAPDH band of the BPDE lane is lighter than the IR lanes. IR 10 Gy: WWOX unchanged, FHIT slightly stronger, p21 strongly up, GAPDH equal. 'Dramatic' is stronger than the BPDE panel.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 1A BPDE and IR sections: BPDE 0.5 WWOX band weaker than BPDE 0 but visible; IR 0 and IR 10 WWOX bands equal; FHIT IR 10 slightly darker; p21 up with BPDE and IR.
entries.anchor: Figure 1A (PDF p.13), native tiles x1178-2357 y0-2800 and the BPDE 0 lane edge of x0-1179

entries.proposition: p53-INDEPENDENCE: UV lowers WWOX and FHIT in p53-null Saos-2. DATO for Saos-2; 'p53-independent' is INFERENZA from one null line of a different tissue, with no p53 knockdown in MCF-7.
entries.snippet: UV irradiation downregulated the levels of FHIT and WWOX transcripts in Saos-2 cells, indicating that the repressive effect of UV on the fragile site genes was a p53-independent phenomenon (Figure 2).

entries.proposition: FIGURE 2, NATIVE TILES (2574x4200). Saos-2 UV 10 J/m2 -/+: WWOX band at - and near background at +; FHIT clear at -, faint at +; p21 up with UV; GAPDH equal. Agrees with the text.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 2: WWOX strong without UV and near background with UV; FHIT weaker with UV; GAPDH equal in both lanes.

entries.proposition: PROTEIN LAGS mRNA: no considerable WWOX protein fall at 24 h after one dose. DATO.
entries.snippet: the protein expression level did not decrease considerably at 24 h.
entries.anchor: Results > Repeated UV Irradiation Reduces the Level of WWOX Protein, sentence 1

entries.proposition: REPEATED UV: WWOX protein falls at 48 h (2x) and 72 h (3x). DATO.
entries.snippet: A considerable decrease in the protein expression was observed following multiple UV-C irradiations (24 h apart) at later time points (48 and 72 h), as shown by Western blot analysis (Figure 3).
entries.anchor: Results > Repeated UV Irradiation Reduces the Level of WWOX Protein, sentence 2

entries.proposition: AUTHORS INFER WWOX PROTEIN IS 'relatively stable'. INFERENZA (theirs): no half-life, cycloheximide chase or degradation assay was performed.
entries.snippet: This suggests that the WWOX protein is relatively stable, and repeated genotoxic insults are required to cause a considerable decrease in protein levels.
entries.anchor: Results > Repeated UV Irradiation Reduces the Level of WWOX Protein, sentence 3

entries.proposition: FIGURE 3, NATIVE TILES (4200x1782). Lanes 0 h (-), 24 h (1x), 48 h (2x), 72 h (3x), 72 h (-). WWOX: strong, strong, reduced, faint, strong. Actin: similar, except the 72 h 3x lane, which is HEAVIER than the others - so the fall at 72 h is not underloading. One blot, no quantification, no untreated 24 h or 48 h lane, no single-dose 48/72 h lane: the design cannot separate cumulative dose from elapsed time since the first dose, and it measures no turnover rate.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 3: lane labels Hr 0 24 48 72 72 and UV - 1x 2x 3x -; WWOX band strong strong weaker faint strong; actin band broadest in the 72 h 3x lane.

entries.proposition: FHIT PROTEIN UNCHANGED, data not shown. DATO as a statement.
entries.snippet: However, we did not observe any significant reduction in levels of this protein (data not shown).
entries.anchor: Results > Repeated UV Irradiation Reduces the Level of WWOX Protein

entries.proposition: UV RAISES THE S-PHASE FRACTION. DATO.
entries.snippet: Flow cytometric analyses of UV-irradiated MCF-7 cells revealed that the fraction of cells in S-phase increased considerably in the total cell population (Figure 4A) indicating that UV-induced an S-phase checkpoint.

entries.proposition: IR GIVES G2 ARREST. DATO.
entries.snippet: On the other hand, IR-induced a G2 arrest in MCF-7 cells (Figure 4B).

entries.proposition: UV REDUCES [3H]-THYMIDINE UPTAKE at 24 h. DATO.
entries.snippet: a significant UV-C-induced reduction in the incorporation of [3H]-Thymidine was observed at 24 h posttreatment.

entries.proposition: CAFFEINE abrogates the S-phase delay and 'significantly overcame' the UV repression of WWOX and FHIT mRNA. DATO as stated; 'significantly' has no statistic behind it.
entries.snippet: treatment of MCF-7 cells with caffeine abrogated the S-phase delay (Figure 4A) and significantly overcame the repression by UV of WWOX and FHIT expression (Figure 5A).

entries.proposition: FIGURE 4, NATIVE TILES (1882x4200). A: UV-/caf- G1 ~47, S ~37, G2/M ~16%; UV+/caf- ~30/~45/~25; UV+/5 mM ~63/~29/~9; UV+/10 mM ~55/~28/~17. Caffeine does more than abrogate the delay: S falls BELOW the unirradiated control and G1 rises ABOVE it, and there is no caffeine-without-UV bar. B: IR- ~49/~34/~19; IR+ ~36/~14/~52 (G2/M). C: CPM ~133,000 vs ~25,000 with UV.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 4: panel A four groups UV - + + + and caffeine - - 5 10, S bars ~37 ~45 ~29 ~28; panel B IR G2/M bar ~52; panel C CPM ~133000 versus ~25000.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 5A, NATIVE TILES (3298x4200). Lanes caffeine -/UV -, -/+, 5/+, 10/+. WWOX: strong, faint, moderate, strong. FHIT: clear, faint, faint, moderate. p21 weak without UV, strong in all three UV lanes. GAPDH HEAVIER in the 10 mM lane. There is NO caffeine-only lane. The recovery at 5 mM is partial, the 10 mM recovery is partly a loading difference, and a direct effect of caffeine on WWOX mRNA is not excluded.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 5A: caffeine - - 5 10 and UV - + + +; WWOX strong faint moderate strong; GAPDH darkest in the 10 mM lane; no lane with caffeine and no UV.

entries.proposition: WWOX mRNA NOT CELL-CYCLE REGULATED after serum release. DATO as stated.
entries.snippet: We observed normal levels of WWOX mRNA after serum starvation (G1 arrest) that remained unchanged as the cells progressed through the S- and G2/M-phases (Figure 5B).

entries.proposition: FIGURE 5B, NATIVE TILES. Serum 0, 4, 8, 12, 24 h: WWOX roughly constant; cyclin E absent at 0 and rising from 8 h; GAPDH lighter at 24 h. The cell-cycle phases are inferred from time and cyclin E; no flow profile of the release is shown.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 5B: WWOX bands similar at 0 4 8 12 24 h; cyclin E absent at 0 and strong at 12 and 24 h; GAPDH lighter at 24 h.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 4C: triplicates plotted. DATO.
entries.snippet: Triplicate values for each treatment were plotted in the graphs.

entries.proposition: AUTHOR MODEL 1: differential response via ATR (UV) vs ATM (IR). IPOTESI; neither kinase was measured or inhibited specifically.
entries.snippet: Thus, the downregulation of FHIT and WWOX expression by UV and BPDE but not by IR could therefore be a consequence of qualitative differences between the ATR- and ATM-mediated response pathways.

entries.proposition: AUTHOR MODEL 1 WITHDRAWN a paragraph later: the caffeine result is taken to argue AGAINST ATR-Chk1, while the same Discussion attributes the S-phase delay caffeine abolishes to a checkpoint (ref 57 calls carcinogen S-arrest Chk1-mediated and caffeine-sensitive). INFERENZA (theirs), internally in tension.
entries.snippet: suggests that the ATR-Chk1 signaling pathway is unlikely to be the major mechanism behind the observed repressive phenomenon.

entries.proposition: AUTHOR MODEL 2: bulky adducts block transcription of very long genes. IPOTESI; no adduct, polymerase or nascent-RNA measurement.
entries.snippet: These bulky adducts represent strong blocks to both transcription and replication, and could directly affect the expression of genes such as FHIT and WWOX, which produce extremely long transcripts.

entries.proposition: 'CLEARLY DEMONSTRATED ... in a coordinated manner': the data are single representative Northerns in two lines; coordination is co-occurrence, not a shared mechanism shown.
entries.snippet: In this study, we have clearly demonstrated that the two most commonly altered fragile site genes WWOX/FRA16D and FHIT/FRA3B are downregulated in a coordinated manner by the common environmental carcinogens, UV and BPDE.

entries.proposition: THE mRNA FALL IS TRANSIENT after one 10 J/m2 dose: visible by 3 h, deepest 18-24 h, transcripts back at 48 h (data not shown). DATO as a statement only.
entries.snippet: In time-course experiments, such reduction was noticeable as early as 3 h postirradiation and dramatically reduced by 18 and 24 h, however, at 48 h the WWOX transcripts re-appeared (data not shown).

entries.proposition: TUMOUR-INITIATION HYPOTHESIS from protracted exposure. IPOTESI.
entries.snippet: We hypothesize that such a continuous (transcriptional) silencing of fragile site associated putative tumor suppressor genes such as WWOX and FHIT by protracted exposure to environmental carcinogens may play a significant role in the initiation and development of cancer.

entries.proposition: CITED CONVERGENT RESULT in vivo: methyleugenol lowers Wwox and Fhit in mouse liver (Iida 2005). Not measured here.
entries.snippet: reported that the genotoxic carcinogen methyleugenol induces a marked reduction of Wwox and Fhit expression in mouse liver while the noncarcinogenic congener eugenol has no effect.

entries.proposition: CITED INDEPENDENT REPLICATION with a different checkpoint attribution (G1-S): Ishii 2005, ref 65.
entries.snippet: reported that UV irradiation resulted in the reduction of WWOX and FHIT gene expression and suggested a role for the G1-S checkpoint.
